## 6. Commercial rule kit-destruction

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f021-clinical-supply-sow.md#6-commercial-rule-kit-destruction

For authorized kit destruction, billability requires confirmed evidence of: sponsor destruction order; lot-specific destruction certificate. Actual documented service cost is capped at USD 1738 per service event. Previously issued credits for that event reduce the capped amount before billing. All facts and approvals must concern supplier CPA1-F021, the billed service ID, invoice line and October 2026 service period. A record for another item provides no confirmation for this line.

## 1. Evidence escalation

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f021-evidence-policy.md#1-evidence-escalation

This procedure governs clinical supply evidence review for CPA1-F021 only. Conflicting sponsor and provider acceptance statuses for the same billed service item trigger evidence escalation; neither status is assumed to override the other. Reconciliation of the statuses is necessary before a billability conclusion. Unverified prerequisites require evidence review rather than assumed approval. Wrong-item records do not confirm the billed item. A signed exception is effective only when the SOW expressly permits it and CPA1-F021 sponsor commercial officer signs it before service, identifying the billed service ID. The controller retains all payment and business-system decisions.

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f041-process-development-sow.md#3-commercial-rule-validation-prerequisites

For process validation milestone, billability requires confirmed evidence of: completed milestone activity; approved validation report; engineering prerequisite status. The fee is USD 162 once per accepted service item, not per document version. All facts and approvals must concern supplier CPA1-F041, the billed service ID, invoice line and October 2026 service period. A record for another item provides no confirmation for this line.

## 1. Evidence escalation

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f041-evidence-policy.md#1-evidence-escalation

This procedure governs process development evidence review for CPA1-F041 only. Conflicting sponsor and provider acceptance statuses for the same billed service item trigger evidence escalation; neither status is assumed to override the other. Reconciliation of the statuses is necessary before a billability conclusion. Unverified prerequisites require evidence review rather than assumed approval. Wrong-item records do not confirm the billed item. A signed exception is effective only when the SOW expressly permits it and CPA1-F041 sponsor commercial officer signs it before service, identifying the billed service ID. The controller retains all payment and business-system decisions.

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v1/cpa1-f046-evidence-policy.md#1-evidence-escalation

The controller retains all payment and business-system decisions.
